title: BCWO Hell Hub Premium
features:
Combat Modifications
• Instant Kill - Automatically eliminates targeted mobs/bosses
• Auto Farm - Automated resource/XP collection without user input
• God Mode - Invincibility/damage immunity
• Aimbot/Silent Aim - Automated targeting and shooting assistance
• Rapid Fire - Increases weapon fire rate beyond normal limits
•Visual Enhancements (ESP)
• Player ESP - Highlights enemy players through walls with colored boxes/names
• Item ESP - Reveals item locations through terrain/structures
• Health/Name Display - Shows player stats above characters
Movement Exploits
• Fly Mode - Removes gravity constraints, allowing free flight
• Speed Modification - WalkSpeed slider (16-500, default is 16)
• Jump Power - Jump height modifier (50-500, default is 50)
• Infinite Jump - Allows continuous jumping in mid-air
Utility Features
• Mobile/Desktop Detection - Automatically adapts UI layout based on input device
• Tabbed Interface - Organized sections (Combat, Visuals, Movement, Misc)
• Animated UI - Smooth transitions, loading screens, gradient effects
• Configuration System - Saves settings per device type
